tools.title: Crisp

servers.name: Crisp MCP Server
servers.capabilities: Read workspace data and perform write operations such as changing a conversation's state or sending messages, a subset of the REST API.

tools.notes: Uses an MCP Server token generated in Settings > Workspace Settings > Advanced configuration, sent as an Authorization Bearer header.

tools.title: Freshdesk

servers.name: Freshworks MCP server for Freshdesk
servers.capabilities: 36 tools over tickets, replies and notes, contacts, agents, groups, companies and solution articles.

tools.notes: GA since 10 Sep 2026 on Growth, Pro and Enterprise with yearly action quotas; API key in the Authorization header; custom domains are not supported for the endpoint.

tools.title: Front
tools.summary: Shared inbox and customer operations platform.

servers.name: Front MCP server
servers.capabilities: Search and read conversations, manage drafts and send them, change status, assign, tag, comment, create tasks, read contacts and accounts.

tools.notes: Requires a Front developer app (client ID and secret; no dynamic client registration) or a directory install by a Front admin. Front's community calls the server a beta.

tools.title: Intercom
tools.summary: Customer messaging, help desk and Fin AI agent.

servers.name: Intercom MCP server
servers.capabilities: Search and read conversations, contacts, companies, articles and audiences; add internal notes, create and update articles; Fin Operator tools with OAuth.

tools.notes: EU workspaces must use https://mcp.eu.intercom.com/mcp; AU-hosted workspaces are not supported. The /sse endpoints are deprecated.

tools.title: Zendesk
tools.summary: Customer service help desk and ticketing.

servers.name: Zendesk MCP server (Zendesk Bridge)
servers.capabilities: Look up tickets, users, organizations and help center content; create or update tickets and business rules after human confirmation.
servers.access: Search, read and analyse Zendesk data; create and update tickets and business rules such as triggers, each change proposed and confirmed by a person first.
servers.scopes: Each user authorizes the app for their own Zendesk account (OAuth); admins choose in Admin Center whether only admins or selected agent groups use the connection. Plans: Suite Team to Enterprise Plus or Support Team to Enterprise, free during early access. The page names no scope list.

tools.notes: Early access program (free during EAP, pricing may change): an admin creates the connection under Admin Center > AI > External AI and copies the exact URL from its Setup tab; the URL above is the documented example pattern.
